deletedScenes.title: Extended Weapons Testing Montage

deletedScenes.title: Yinsen Backstory
deletedScenes.description: An extended conversation between Tony and Yinsen revealing more about Yinsen's past as a scientist and his family.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Yinsen shares personal stories that deepen the emotional connection between him and Tony.

deletedScenes.title: Obadiah's Manipulation Scene
deletedScenes.description: An early scene showing Obadiah Stane subtly manipulating board members at Stark Industries.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Shows Obadiah's cunning and his strategic moves to take control of the company.

deletedScenes.title: Tony's Party Extended Cut
deletedScenes.description: Longer footage from Tony's famous party scene with more interactions and dialogue before Rhodes intervenes.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Shows more of Tony's reckless behavior and his deteriorating relationships at the party.

deletedScenes.title: Ivan Vanko's Prison Release
deletedScenes.description: An additional scene showing how Ivan Vanko is released from prison and begins his quest for revenge.

deletedScenes.title: Pepper and Tony Relationship Scene
deletedScenes.description: An intimate scene between Pepper and Tony discussing their complicated relationship and his spiral.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Shows the emotional stakes of Tony's deteriorating health and his effect on those close to him.

deletedScenes.title: Black Widow's Early Infiltration
deletedScenes.description: Extended scenes of Natasha Romanoff investigating Stark Industries before revealing herself.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Shows more of Black Widow's reconnaissance and her initial observations of Tony.

deletedScenes.title: Mandarin's Original Backstory
deletedScenes.description: Extended scenes revealing the Mandarin's true history before the twist reveal, as originally filmed.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Provides context for the Mandarin character that was altered by the final reveal.

deletedScenes.title: Tony's Panic Attack Sequence
deletedScenes.description: An expanded scene showing Tony's PTSD and anxiety issues following the events of The Avengers.

deletedScenes.title: Harley's Backstory Expansion
deletedScenes.description: More scenes with the kid Harley, expanding his relationship with Tony and his home situation.

deletedScenes.title: Extremis Soldier Creation
deletedScenes.description: Extended montage of the Extremis enhancement process and its effects on test subjects.

deletedScenes.title: Loki's Early Scheming
deletedScenes.description: Extended scenes of Loki plotting with the Other and preparing his invasion strategy.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Provides deeper context for Loki's motivations and his partnership with the Chitauri.

deletedScenes.title: Tony and Captain America Conflict
deletedScenes.description: Additional scene of tension between Tony and Steve Rogers in the Helicarrier before the attack.

deletedScenes.title: Fury's Recruitment Montage
deletedScenes.description: Extended scenes showing Nick Fury recruiting each Avenger for the team.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Shows how each hero was brought into the Avengers initiative with individual approaches.

deletedScenes.title: Black Widow's First Meeting with Hawkeye
deletedScenes.description: Extended backstory scene of how Natasha and Clint first met in S.H.I.E.L.D.

deletedScenes.title: The Original Heist Planning

deletedScenes.title: Tony's Farewell Montage

deletedScenes.title: Captain America's Timeline Story

deletedScenes.title: Hulk's Time Heist Complications

deletedScenes.title: The Final Battle Extended Cut
deletedScenes.description: Additional action sequences from the final battle, including scenes that didn't make the theatrical cut.
deletedScenes.synopsis: Expands the epic final battle with more character moments and combat choreography.
